reading: Two companies, one rewired and one not yet. United States, T-Mobile US: on one system that holds what the company knows about each customer, the share of chat conversations that never reached a person was about a quarter in mid-2024 and 78% in mid-2026, company figures; the two values are drawn as two separate strips of dots, one dot is 2%, nothing drawn between them. Germany and Europe, Deutsche Telekom: customers prove who they are in 14 different ways, which Telekom plans to cut to 3, a target; above that list its slide says "Simplify before automating".
headline: Rewired, and not yet rewired

us.measure: chat conversations that never reached a person
us.between: nothing published in between; no line drawn

base.label: rebuilt underneath: one system holding what the company knows about each customer

de.measure: ways customers prove who they are, across its European countries

why: The share of chats is T-Mobile's own figure from its investor deck (R6-06): about a quarter in mid-2024, 78% in mid-2026; the values in between are not published, so the two strips are not joined. The rebuilt customer system is from T-Mobile's head of IT at the investor day (R6-02) and its annual report (R6-09). The 14 ways and the plan to cut them to 3 and the principle "Simplify before automating" are from Telekom's investor-day slides (R6-05); 3 is a plan, so it is drawn hollow.
